correctness.rationale: A cyclically independent prescribed ear set has a deletion bijection with triangulations of a smaller convex polygon, producing the all-subsets joint probability. Adjacent ears are incompatible. From single and pair moments, exact covariance is (p-q)I-qH+(q-p^2)J, whose Fourier eigenvalues follow algebraically. Positivity is verified for n≥8 by p-3q≥0, with explicit n=5,6,7 bounds, proving rank. Catalan ratios converge to 4^{-k}; the resulting mixed moments coincide with the fair-bit 01 process, and Boolean Möbius inversion proves finite-dimensional distribution convergence. The standalone script independently enumerates all triangulations through n=11 and checks exact joint moments, rational ranks and Fourier eigenvectors; its finite checks are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: Ear location is a canonical local random geometric feature of uniform Catalan triangulations. The exact all-subsets law and full covariance spectrum characterize arbitrary position-weighted ear fluctuations, detect a sharp finite-size rank transition (pentagon singular, at least six vertices nonsingular), and reveal that nonneighbor ear indicators are positively dependent despite exclusion of neighbors. The local fair-bit 01 limit provides an interpretable one-dependent infinite-volume model. These are natural complete positional probabilistic invariants, beyond total ear-count enumeration, not a chosen arbitrary slice or a numeric improvement.
